failure.message: systemd SIGTERM'd this attempt at the --hwnoise-duration timeout-bound defect (fixed in commit b29e819): the unit's timeout did not sum in the 900s hwnoise capture window, so it terminated the process mid-run rather than after the full attempt completed. Root cause and the resulting osnoise-kthread starvation of the next run's cyclictest are recorded in .planning/phases/01-trustworthy-measurement/deferred-items.md, section 'From 01-23 (a killed rtla leaves osnoise kthreads that D-06 cannot see, 2026-09-06)'. The cyclictest.hist/.json/.stderr.txt files in this directory are real, harness-produced raw output from before the kill; no rtla-hwnoise.txt exists because the firmware-screen phase had not finished writing one when the process died. This ATTEMPT.json was left at status in-progress because the harness's own exit paths (which always rewrite the record as completed or failed) never ran. `nrmeasure attempt` corrected it to failed at 2026-09-07T02:32:27.407871Z (RFC 3339), after the fact, rather than a hand edit; utc_end above is the documented stop time passed to this command, not the correction time.
